units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 78b:3">Snh. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ מנא לן</he> whence do we derive the right of committing to prison (to await the result of wounds afflicted)?—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:5:2">Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>בית ח׳ דר׳ וכ׳</he> the prison where R. Akiba was confined.
